messages:
Mia (partnerships): Quick sync — received revised capacity forecasts from vendors for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi for EU and APAC. Need a concrete routing + fallback plan.
Sam (infra): pls paste the numbers when you have them
Mia (partnerships): H200 EU revised: +12 racks week of 2025-05-12, H100 APAC: steady, MI300 EU: delayed ~2w. Gaudi shipments look good for NA. (see attached spreadsheet link)
Raj (platform): Key ask: we need deterministic fallback rules so customer SLAs don't tank. Suggest priority-based routing + per-region fallthrough to B200 pools.
Ana (solutions): What's the customer impact matrix if MI300 EU slips further? Any embargo constraints for a joint marketplace announcement?
Nate (vendor-nvidia): We're confirming H200 EU shipments hit week of 2025-05-12. ETA subject to HW QC. Will flag any quality-related delays asap.
ops-bot: Reminder: update cluster tags after inventory sync: `gpu.vendor`, `gpu.model`, `gpu.pool`
Sam (infra): Proposed minimal config snippet for routing/fallback (for prod ops runbook):
```
route:
  - match: region: eu
    primary: h200_eu_pool
    fallback: b200_eu_pool
    fallback_ttl: 30
  - match: region: apac
    primary: mi300_apac_pool
    fallback: h100_apac_pool
    fallback_ttl: 45
```
Raj (platform): +1 to Sam's config. Also require adding `served_model` and `served_variant` headers so analytics + billing can slice usage by fallback events.
Mia (partnerships): @Nate can you confirm whether vendor embargo exists for coordinated PR/marketplace listing? We need a go/no-go lead time.
Nate (vendor-nvidia): No formal embargo right now, but vendor comms expect a 7-day heads-up before external marketplace listing. We'll try to narrow the exact window by EOD Friday.
Ana (solutions): Operational note: plan a 24h canary (5 customers) in EU with telemetry hooks for latency, error-rate, and quality regressions. If fallback rate > 3% escalate to oncall.
Sam (infra): I'll add the route to the traffic-router and wire fallback TTLs. Will also add a feature-flag so we can rollback quickly.
Raj (platform): Please ensure metrics: `fallback.count`, `fallback.latency.delta`, and `fallback.model_name` are emitted. We want dashboards per-region/model.
Mia (partnerships): Action items summary:
- @Nate: confirm H200 EU ship week and vendor notice window
- @Sam: implement route + fallback config + feature-flag
- @Raj: expose `served_model` header and fallback metrics
- @Ana: prepare canary customer list and monitoring runbook
- ops-bot: remind team to tag inventory after sync
Mia (partnerships): Anything missing? :thinking:
Raj (platform): Add a short QoR (quality-of-response) probe that runs against the canary set to catch subtle regressions when fallback occurs.
Nate (vendor-nvidia): We'll push any updated ETA or firmware notes into the shared drive and ping the channel.
Ana (solutions): Once canary is green we'll coordinate the marketplace GA window with marketing/legal.
Sam (infra): I'll create the PR and tag it `marketplace-ga` and `hw-routing`. ETA for PR: tomorrow EOD.
Mia (partnerships): Great. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Note: runbook link updated: https://drive.internal/redwood/hw-routing-runbook
